game.desc: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End on Xbox 360 is an action game that brings to life the adventures of the buccaneer Jack Sparrow, played by Johnny Depp in the Disney trilogy. Use your skill, eccentricity and humour to become the greatest pirate of all time! Live and die by the sword is your motto!
